plan.title: Child Fitness Progress Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Comparing baseline and endline performance metrics across locations and coaches

panels.title: Total Children Assessed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT "Child ID" FROM "baseline" UNION ALL SELECT "Child ID" FROM "endline") t

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(b."Sit ups" - e."Sit ups") AS improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Shuttle Run Change
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(e."Shuttle run sec" - b."Shuttle run sec") AS change FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Sit-ups Gain by Location
panels.sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS sit_ups_gain FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

panels.title: Shuttle Run Improvement by Coach
panels.sql: SELECT b."Coach", AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS shuttle_improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

panels.title: Top Locations by Overall Fitness Gain
panels.sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS sit_ups_gain, AVG(b."Shuttle run sec" - e."Shuttle run sec") AS shuttle_gain FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sit_ups_gain DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard tracks the physical progress of children from baseline to endline. The total number of unique children assessed is {{p1}}. On average, participants improved their sit-up count by {{p2}}, indicating better core strength. Conversely, a positive value in {{p3}} would indicate slower times, but since this metric represents seconds, a negative value here signifies faster running times and thus improvement. When analyzing by location, the top performers in sit-ups are shown in {{p4}}, highlighting regional strengths. Similarly, {{p5}} breaks down running speed improvements by coach, helping identify which training methods yielded the best results for shuttle runs.
